question: Who among the following created a national record in the javelin throw event at the third Indian Grand Prix meet in March 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** created a national record in the** javelin throw** event at the third Indian Grand Prix meet in March 2021.
 
• He is a javelin thrower, and became only the second Indian to win an Olympic gold medal.
 
• At the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, he earned a gold medal in the Javelin Throw event.
 
• He became India's seventh medalist and first gold medalist in the Olympics, joining shooter Abhinav Bindra (2008 Beijing Games) as an individual gold medalist.
 
• India won 1 Gold, 2 Silver, and 4 Bronze medals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vipin Kasana** is an Indian athlete who competes in the Javelin throw.
 
• **Shivpal Singh** is an Indian athlete who competes in the Javelin throw.
 
 
• He is from Uttar Pradesh.
 
 
 
• Devendra Jhajharia is associated with the Indian Paralympic javelin throw. 
 
 
• He won his first gold in the javelin throw at the 2004 Summer Paralympics in Athens, becoming only the second gold medalist at the Paralympics for his country.
